summary: Describes Bidirectional PIM, a variant of PIM Sparse-Mode that builds bidirectional shared trees for multicast. A Designated Forwarder election on each link lets data flow to the Rendezvous Point and receivers without source-specific state. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A way for group messages to travel along one shared road in both directions, so routers keep less per-sender info.
